data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1601 (MERGED 2026-08-12), commit 1493064d98 'fsck: repair via rebuild_with_restore' — LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

_repair_ticket now rebuilds through rebuild_with_restore (function-local import, since fsck_restore is imported at the bottom of fsck_repair) and reports restored filenames in disp['restored']. rebuild_with_restore gained a keyword-only no_commit forwarded to rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, defaulting to False so the repair_or_plan call site is unchanged.

All 7 ACs verified: rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log no longer appears anywhere in fsck_repair.py; 5 new tests in tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_repair_restore_08c8.py (RED first — the pre-fix run logged 'REFUSING snapshot rebuild ... Human triage required'); 90 passed on the fsck/repair/restore regression surface; make lint and make typecheck clean.

Note: no ADR or ticket recorded an intentional divergence between the two repair paths — rebuild_with_restore's own docstring already called itself 'the repair path's single entrypoint'.
